title: Next parity node inputs
statement: For natural numbers $r,q$, a group $g$ among the $r^q$ groups, and a sign assignment $a$ on $r$ positions, define a set of positions in the layer of size $r^{q+1}2^r$. It consists of those positions which decode to a group of the form obtained from $g$ and some $j\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$, and whose decoded sign vector has product different from $a(j)$.
